mfa_verification_log.notes: User reported suspicious email, flagged for SOC review

indicators: High AI-phishing score (92) from email gateway
Email SPF pass for newly registered domain differing from known CEO domain
Base64-encoded audio attachment with deepfake artifacts
Unusual URL redirecting through obfuscated domain resembling legitimate enterprise URL
Out-of-band MFA verification declined and raised alert
examples.detection_method: Deploy advanced AI-content detection tools integrated with email gateways to analyze voice and video attachments for deepfake indicators; use behavioral email analysis to detect linguistic anomalies; monitor domain registration feeds for newly created domains mimicking corporate identities; enforce multi-factor and out-of-band verification for all high-value wire transfer requests; use network monitoring to identify suspicious SMTP sessions originating from unrecognized IPs or domains.
